text:
You need a way to automatically compare Bing Ads search query data against a white list and add the right negative keywords without manual work.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’ve spent 5 years working in data analysis, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization. In a Parent survey analysis project for Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response survey and wrote the findings for the board; 3 findings were adopted in the next funding plan. In a Subscription churn cohorts project for a SaaS client, I built monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan plus an onboarding funnel; one onboarding step was linked to 40% of first-month churn.  

I can help design the data logic, automate keyword decisions, and document the workflow clearly. What criteria should the app use when a search query is close to the white list but not an exact match?
